quest.title: Ever-Surging Memories
quest.description: Neuvillette comes up with another way to investigate — using his powers to search for memories and emotions within the Fountain of Lucine. You hope everything goes as planned...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: The Remains of the Past Day

talks.objective: Go to the Fountain of Lucine

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Looks like we got lucky today — there's hardly anyone around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we do next?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, can you still hear voices from the fountain?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps leave the investigation to me. I need you to take a few steps back and keep a safe distance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A safe distance? Neuvillette, what exactly are you—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, it's glowing!

choices.text: Should I drink more Primordial Seawater?

dialogues.speaker: Corneille
dialogues.text: I must keep the Melusines safe.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: I just can't sit back and watch...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What just happened?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Everything looks a little different than how they are normally... I should continue forward and take a look around.)

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Thank you for bringing us here, Monsieur Neuvillette.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: The Court of Fontaine is truly incredible. There's so many things I've never seen or heard before...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I understand your excitement, but there's no need to thank me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Although I've responded to your wishes, it was not without personal interest. Melusines' special sight makes them especially suited for joining the Marechaussee Phantom. I am certain you'll become an indispensable part of Fontaine's detective force.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: I know, but I'm really glad to be of help!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Not only can I repay you for your kindness, but also... it feels like my life has become a lot more meaningful.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But a meaningful life also comes with its risks.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: It's definitely the safest to just stay in the village, but I want to see the outside world nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: In truth, I've never really understood the purpose of my existence, or what I'm capable of contributing to this world.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: For almost twenty years, we've stayed in our village without finding any answers. That's why we wanted to leave our village and look for the meaning of our existence elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I understand your confusion. In fact, I feel the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I, too, came here for an answer to my questions about my own existence.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Really? Could you tell us what we should do to fit in as you did?

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: The truth is... many people threw rocks at us today and told us to go back to our village. It hurt a lot when they hit me in the head... and I tried really hard not to cry.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Logically speaking, both time and effort are essential when different species attempt to peacefully co-exist. It will be a difficult road ahead, with countless obstacles to overcome.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Different identities and ways of thinking all contribute to strengthening the barrier between one another. Removing it will be no easy feat.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: There aren't many suggestions I can share, because just like you, I haven't fully integrated into this society. Despite my social status, I'm still an outsider.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... Let's all do our best, then!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: I'm confident that we'll find the meaning of our existence one day.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I believe in you, but you shouldn't lose sight of the difficulties ahead. If you run into any trouble, I suggest that you inform Vautrin, the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Huh? Is he the person I met in the Palais Mermonia earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes. Do you have any concerns?

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: That stone-faced human... He didn't even bother to look at me when I tried talking to him! It felt like he wasn't interested in anything but work.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: He is an earnest man. There will be plenty of opportunities to work together in the future, so please try to get along.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Hello, can I help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Thanks, but no need.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Hello! I'm Carole, a Melusine! Is there anything you need help with?

dialogues.speaker: Simone
dialogues.text: Get away from here! I'm calling the Gardes!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Please calm down... I don't mean to cause any harm.

dialogues.speaker: Simone
dialogues.text: Hmph, hard to say.

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: Yeah, we should probably stay away from these monsters. Haven't you realized? Strange incidents have been increasing ever since they came.

dialogues.speaker: Simone
dialogues.text: Why should we trust this species from who-knows-where anyway? I can't believe Neuvillette allowed them into the Court of Fontaine just like that.

dialogues.speaker: Clodomir
dialogues.text: Exactly! That so-called Chief Justice even granted them official positions. Not only that, but they're now responsible for investigating cases as well! I swear there's some hidden agenda at play here.

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: Go away! Quit acting innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: I'm not leaving! I won't let you say bad stuff about him!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: We joined the Marechaussee Phantom and solved lots and lots of cases... We've never done anything wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: Solving cases? With Neuvillette in cahoots with you! You could've fabricated it all, and no one would know!

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: So tell me, how can you guarantee that you Melusines aren't involved in anything that occurred recently?
Didn't I tell you before? Don't go advertising if you're not a good talker.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Vautrin?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Aside from spreading unjustified rumors, if you continue insulting members of the Marechaussee Phantom, the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol has every right to subject you to interrogation.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: There have indeed been an increase in cases recently — perhaps due to the shifting currents of conspiracy, and I understand your concern. However, there has been no evidence pointing towards Melusines being involved.

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: Tsk, even the Captain of the Security Patrol is on their side. Neuvillette's newly "reformed" police force is already corrupt to the core...

dialogues.speaker: Simone
dialogues.text: How can two completely different species possibly coexist?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: You heard that?

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: I don't understand... Why won't anyone believe us?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: There have been rumors saying that you were born from calamity... and that you inherently bring danger to those around you.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: There are countless negative rumors about you floating around in Fontaine. It's near impossible for you to become a part of this society... best if you give up before it's too late.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette said that we needed to put both time and effort in. I don't know how long it'll take, but I can at least try making my best effort.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: I still want to try a little harder. Thank you for bailing me out earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Okay, I won't be taking any more of your time. I painted a lot of flyers last night, so I have to stay and hand them out to everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Give them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Y—You're not gonna take them away... right?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: We'll hand them out together. The faster we get this done, the sooner we can head back.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette, what's this?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Medals of Peace, awarded to you and Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you for your continuous dedication in the past five years. You've taken one small step forward in helping Melusines gain the trust of humans.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: I think I'll pass...

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Hey, don't say that. We wouldn't have made it this far without you!

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: It won't be long before Melusines begin living peacefully with the humans... Just the thought of it makes me happy.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Don't keep your hopes up. We've barely scratched the surface. There's still a long way to go before that dream of yours comes true.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: Ugh, you blockhead! Don't ruin the mood!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Vautrin brings up a good point. The trust humans have placed in you is still very fragile. Any small incident could undermine the hard work you've put in.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Please be on your guard for the next few days.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Yes, Sir.

dialogues.speaker: Carole
dialogues.text: ...Okay, got it.

dialogues.speaker: Thibert
dialogues.text: Medal of Peace? Ha, "peace" isn't going to give us back what's rightfully ours.

dialogues.speaker: Suavegothe
dialogues.text: Are you sure we should do this? We're no match for Neuvillette, even with all our powers combined. What if...

dialogues.speaker: Thibert
dialogues.text: Nah, not gonna happen. As long as he remains in his position, there's no chance he'd take us out personally.

dialogues.speaker: Thibert
dialogues.text: There are rules even he must comply with in the political sphere... unless he wants to become an enemy of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Thibert
dialogues.text: So quit worrying and just go ahead with it. I've already planned out the murder. Once we lay the blame on the Melusines, as the person who brought them to the Court of Fontaine, Neuvillette will be left with no excuse.

dialogues.speaker: Suavegothe
dialogues.text: I guess you're right. Ugh, if he'd just left things the way they were, it never would've had to come to this... But he's forced our hand. Time to teach him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: The results of the investigation are in, Captain Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Go on.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: There is no direct evidence, but reasonable inference indicates that the ones controlling the situation are supporters of the old regime whose interests have been undermined by the reform.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: They tricked Miss Carole into going to the crime scene and pressed charges against her. After that, they incited panic among the people in order to make Monsieur Neuvillette confess to his mistakes and yield up power.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: The Gardes were stopped by the enraged mob and couldn't intervene in time. Miss Carole... chose to sacrifice herself to pacify the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: And she called ME a blockhead...!

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: A little investigation would've cleared things up! Why didn't she wait until we'd established the truth? She didn't have to prove her innocence like that...

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: The situation had rapidly escalated to a physical altercation between infuriated citizens and the Gardes. Miss Carole might've thought there was no better plan...

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: *sigh* That is indeed something she'd do.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: Captain Vautrin, should I present these results to Monsieur Neuvillette right away?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: There's no need. Notify the Gardes to restrict public access to all information.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: Restrict access to... Wait, are you planning to—

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: There's something I've never told Carole — I had a little sister named Illaria who passed away when I was very young.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: She's just like Carole in every possible way. Innocent, kind... always believing the best of people. People like her are the most vulnerable to deception and betrayal.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: From the moment I met Carole, I knew that she'd be easily manipulated by others. I kept a cold demeanor and tried lecturing her into giving up...

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: ...Looks like she was unfazed by that.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Yes. In fact, some of her spirit must've rubbed off on me instead... because I too began working towards that pie-in-the-sky dream of hers.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: I should've known. Those cowards don't have the guts to confront Neuvillette — they even avoided causing trouble for me... They were after Carole all along.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Can you understand how I feel? Right now, there's only one thought on my mind: Only through bloodshed can their debt be repaid.

dialogues.speaker: Rastignac
dialogues.text: I understand, but I'm certain Monsieur Neuvillette wouldn't accept that as a solution.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: That's exactly why we need to keep this a secret. Give me the list of suspects. What happens after this has nothing to do with any of you.

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: I will take responsibility for everything.

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Did you know? They're hearing a major case today, and the criminal is Captain Vautrin of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol!

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Apparently, he resorted to personal measures to seek revenge for Carole and settled the score with the group that framed his friend... Hey, why aren't you saying anything?

dialogues.speaker: Lothaire
dialogues.text: I'm thinking... We should try our best to bail him out when the trial commences.

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Bail him out? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Lothaire
dialogues.text: Shh, keep it down. Haven't you realized? Both Vautrin and Carole are Neuvillette's most trusted subordinates. After everything that happened to Carole, Neuvillette's guaranteed to do everything he can to keep Vautrin around.

dialogues.speaker: Lothaire
dialogues.text: Besides, now that the old regime has been uprooted, Neuvillette's status is secure as can be. As long as we redirect public opinion, Neuvillette will be able to give Vautrin a reprieve. The benefits are endless...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A raucous commotion gradually began to rise in the opera house...

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Vautrin sought vengeance for his friend for a valid cause. This represents the justice he upholds!

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Please think about it. If the same thing had happened to you, wouldn't you feel the same way as he did?

dialogues.speaker: Prume
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right!

dialogues.speaker: Lothaire
dialogues.text: This whole thing started because of those despicable cowards who levied false accusations against Carole! How could Vautrin be declared guilty for seeking revenge?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: Mr. Vautrin is innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: He's innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Order.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I acknowlege your arguments. Vautrin, your revenge could be seen as a form of justice.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I understand your decision. Which is why I cannot help but feel regret... and even grief about the judgment I must now impose.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: However, personal justice does not equate to justice as defined by the law. To execute your plan for revenge, you abused your authority and conducted informal executions. Your actions have thus violated the law.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Therefore, you will be declared... guilty.

dialogues.speaker: Baderico
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Lothaire
dialogues.text: That can't be... Monsieur Neuvillette, please give this a little more thought. He has done so much for Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Vautrin... my friend. Is there anything else you want to say?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: What have I done to deserve this? I've closely followed every one of your orders! Can't you see? Everyone in this room believes that I'm innocent... why can't you just let me off!?

dialogues.speaker: Vautrin
dialogues.text: Is this what justice means to you? Answer me, Neuvillette!!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...Order.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Since there have been no further objections, the Oratrice will now deliver the final verdict regarding the charges against Mr. Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: According to the judgment of the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, Mr. Vautrin will be declared... guilty.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Goodbye, Monsieur Neuvillette."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "This all happened because of Carole's naive ideas..."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "How can different species peacefully coexist anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, stop spacing out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what's wrong? Are you not feeling well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What was that...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Apologies, it seems like my memories got the better of me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I tried my best to suppress the power of Hydro within myself, but it seems like it still caused the emotions within the Fountain of Lucine to boil over.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Due to my negligence, the overflow of emotions and memories must have affected you as well. Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! The Hydro Dragon is more powerful than Paimon thought...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Anyway, the last time we came here, {NICKNAME} only heard voices from the Fountain of Lucine... No "emotions boiling over" or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It is as you said. This might be because I'm different.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It is not only the Fountain. I can sense emotions from all waters in Fontaine. Rivers, lakes... and even the rain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But I rarely ever do anything like this. Emotions carried by water are always chaotic and disconnected. As an outsider, having my mind occupied with irrelevant memories isn't exactly a pleasant experience.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The memories I saw were related to you.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Which ones?

choices.text: From when you brought Carole to the Court of Fontaine...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It's fine. I prefer not to speak of those memories, but that does not mean I am deliberately hiding them.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It was a coincidence, but perhaps it is a good thing that you saw everything in that form.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You should now understand why I believe there to be a conspiracy behind all this... These two cases are much too similar. I felt like I needed to do something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon's starting to lose track of what you're saying...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't leave Paimon out of the conversation! Paimon wants to help too!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Then let us get back to the point. While I was investigating the Fountain, I discovered something strange.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I did not sense too much hatred towards me within its accumulated emotions.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I don't know what caused this to happen, but it seems like there won't be a shortcut to finding the organization that may be pulling the strings here.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: However, I did find some resentment directed towards Kiara. If I remember correctly, it seemed to be related to a smuggling case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Didn't we read about that in one of those documents?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You've read about it? In that case, the resentment should've come from that incident—

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Huh, what are you doing here? I was just about to look for you at the Palais Mermonia.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Navia! Nice to see you again! Is there something we can help with?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I've heard some things... But I'm not purposely asking around or anything, don't worry!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Rumors are abroad that someone's scheming against Melusines, and that you're investigating the case.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: So I told the Spina di Rosula to keep an eye out for leads. We've had unfamiliar faces showing themselves at the Fleuve Cendre lately. Maybe you'll find the suspects among them.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: ...Where did you hear about all this?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: #The Chief Justice out on investigation, accompanied by {NICKNAME} from afar... No matter how you conceal your whereabouts, there will be countless eyes watching you.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: You talked to Kiara, but didn't ask her to keep things secret. People curious to know asked around for information. Then, it was only a matter of time before word of the threatening letter spread all across Fontaine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's what Charlotte meant...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Indeed. I did not expect that this could be kept hidden for too long, but the rumors still spread faster than I imagined.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hmm... You know, it could be because... you attract more attention than you think.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Anyway, any progress with the investigation?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The suspects who threatened Kiara might have to do with a certain smuggling case, but it is still uncertain if there is, in fact, another party behind all this.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: We are planning to return to the Palais Mermonia to revisit some details and identify the senders of that threatening letter.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Alright, then I'll round up the Spina di Rosula and follow up on their progress.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Wait for my word. Ta-ta!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Neuvillette, do you think there will be any problems now that the word is out?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I have already considered that possibility, and I do not think there will be any. As a matter of fact, once the word gets out, no one would dare to harm Kiara in broad daylight.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: What is more important is how the case is perceived by the public. Four hundred years ago, they chose to side with the old regime and direct their resentment towards the Melusines.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: ...I hope the same won't happen again. Let us head back to the Palais.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Strange... What are these people doing out on the streets so late at night?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did something happen? Let's take a look around!

response.speaker: Corneille
response.text: Have you heard? Someone's plotting against a Melusine! This is one hundred percent the truth — even the Chief Justice is investigating in person!

response.speaker: Serrurier
response.text: WHAT? That's it! Who's been threatening Melusines? Show yourself!

response.speaker: Herbier
response.text: Our enemies are lurking in the shadows and won't easily reveal themselves, but no amount of hiding will keep us from finding them!

response.speaker: Corneille
response.text: That's exactly what I wanted to say! The Gardes have already begun to take action... We can't just stand by and watch.

response.speaker: Corneille
response.text: Think about how much we owe them! Now that they're in danger, how can we sit back and do nothing?

response.speaker: Herbier
response.text: Everyone, please stay alert to your surroundings from now on. If you see any suspicious persons, report them to the Gardes immediately.

response.speaker: Veleda
response.text: It feels like you've been following me this whole time. Did something happen?

response.speaker: Delphine
response.text: We were informed that...

response.speaker: Lori
response.text: Ahem! Nope, we just finished our shifts and happened to be strolling by.

response.speaker: Veleda
response.text: Have you had dinner yet? Why don't we check out the new items at the dessert shop together?

response.speaker: Delphine
response.text: This isn't a good time to be out and about.

response.speaker: Lori
response.text: C'mon, don't act tough. I bet you're hungry too.

response.speaker: Delphine
response.text: *sigh* Alright, let's go buy a cake or something.

response.speaker: Veleda
response.text: You shouldn't ever skip meals, especially if you have another shift scheduled for later.

response.speaker: Cooper
response.text: I heard even Neuvillette's keeping an eye on the situation. Haha, this is the perfect chance to get promoted. We gotta make sure we give it all we've got!

response.speaker: Bruno
response.text: Seriously? Were you planning to shirk your duties if Neuvillette wasn't involved?

response.speaker: Cooper
response.text: Relax, I was just playing. We've worked together for years now. If something happened to them, I'd be haunted by regret for the rest of my life.

response.speaker: Bruno
response.text: That's more like it. We should stand guard until the criminal has been caught.

response.speaker: Serrurier
response.text: Come and fight me instead, you cowards!

response.speaker: Corneille
response.text: Have you heard? Even the Special Patrol came to help...

response.speaker: Cooper
response.text: Shh, look! Isn't that Neuvillette? I think he's looking at us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like there's nothing to worry about.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Mm.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: ...This is truly wonderful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sooo... Wanna go over and say hi?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: No, I should stay where I am. My appearance could give rise to unnecessary commotion.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Let us stick to our plan and return to the Palais Mermonia. The faster we uncover the truth, the better.

choices.text: To when you declared Vautrin guilty.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: "The smuggling case was solved by the joint forces of the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom..." This is the one.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The list of involved suspects should be... Ah, found it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does it say?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The principal offenders Domenico, Inika, Youna and others have been caught. They have been sent to the Fortress of Meropide following trial.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Those with close connections or mutual interests with the offenders but who did not participate in the case will not stand trial.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Among them, surveillance of Esseim has ceased on account of his good behavior. All other personnel remain on our watchlist.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many names... Is the one who sent that threatening letter to Kiara on the list?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes. There's something suspicious about Esseim, to be precise.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It seems like he's closely related to the core members of the smuggling case, and he moves around without much restriction.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Should we tell Navia about this?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette, someone claiming to be from the Spina di Rosula just checked in with us.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: He said and I quote, "We have located the suspect. They're chatting at the café."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did Navia find them so quickly? We've only just figured out the suspect's name...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I too am perplexed. The café isn't too far from here. We should head over and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Navia, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, check out all these people... Hey there, are you Navia's friends too?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: These are the people who have had recent dealings with the Marechaussee Phantom. They're usually hidden in the Fleuve Cendre, but I sent for someone to invite them over.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Invite them over?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Exactly. Now, I heard there's great coffee here, and so I asked them if they'd like to come and have some.

dialogues.speaker: Oudinot
dialogues.text: Y—Yeah, it's our pleasure to be guests of the Spina di Rosula...

dialogues.speaker: Massena
dialogues.text: Haha, I've wanted to have a meet-up like this for ages!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, something feels off...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But oh well. Let's get back to business. Is there anyone called Esseim here?

dialogues.speaker: Esseim
dialogues.text: Yes, that's me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You're Esseim?

dialogues.speaker: Esseim
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, Monsieur Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Did you write that threatening letter to Kiara?

dialogues.speaker: Esseim
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Esseim
dialogues.text: I—I did. But I was just following orders...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Orders from whom?

dialogues.speaker: Esseim
dialogues.text: ...Domenico. He was my boss... I couldn't disobey his orders...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Domenico? Where is he now?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, ah, I'm afraid even the Spina would have trouble looking into that place.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Looks like you'll have to make the trip yourselves. This was as much as I could do.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You've done more than enough. I am extremely grateful for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Leave the formalities for later. You should find Domenico first.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If he really is the one setting up the conspiracy, it'd be best if he's exposed as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then, let's head to the Fortress right now!

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "The defendant, Wriothesley, has confessed to his crimes, and was declared guilty by Iudex Neuvillette."

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "Wriothesley will be exiled to the Fortress of Meropide, where he will be serving his sentence."

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "During the trial, Neuvillette remained silent for a long time."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "Callas, boss of the Spina di Rosula, was defeated in the duel and died of serious injuries."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "The defense of his honor has now come to a close. The defendant did not raise any objections throughout the trial."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "Iudex Neuvillette reserved judgment in this case. Its details are still under investigation."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "There has been a severe bribery scandal within the Gardes."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "The Special Security and Surveillance Patrol has investigated the case. All suspects involved have been arrested."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "The suspects have confessed to their crimes."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "The Representative Council has filed a request to collaborate with the Marechaussee Phantom on certain public events."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "Based on research, they believe that Melusines can enhance the popularity of these events."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "The Marechaussee Phantom has yet to respond. However, it has not prohibited the Melusines from participating in such activities."

dialogues.speaker: Boileau
dialogues.text: Are they headed towards the Fountain of Lucine?

dialogues.speaker: Corneille
dialogues.text: I wonder what's going on...

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "The smuggling case was solved by the joint forces of the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom."

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "The principal offenders have received judgment based on the severity of their crimes."

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "Please refer to the appendix for the list of names."

response.speaker: About the smuggling case...
response.text: "The principal offenders Domenico, Inika, Youna and others have been caught. They have been sent to the Fortress of Meropide following trial."

response.speaker: About the smuggling case...
response.text: "Those with close connections or mutual interests with the offenders but who did not participate in the case will not stand trial."

response.speaker: About the smuggling case...
response.text: "Among them, surveillance of Esseim has ceased on account of his good behavior. All other personnel remain on our watchlist."

dialogues.speaker: Serrurier
dialogues.text: Hmph, no one can stay hidden on my watch.

dialogues.speaker: Cooper
dialogues.text: *sigh* All this reminds me of a rumor I've heard.

dialogues.speaker: Bruno
dialogues.text: What rumor?

dialogues.speaker: Cooper
dialogues.text: I've heard that the emblem on our hats didn't always look like this.

dialogues.speaker: Cooper
dialogues.text: A long time ago, Melusines weren't a part of the design. The police emblem only included the scales symbolizing the law.

dialogues.speaker: Cooper
dialogues.text: The emblem was redesigned later on to commemorate a Melusine's sacrifice.

dialogues.speaker: Bruno
dialogues.text: That must've been a long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Neuvillette made an appearance in person! This is the perfect chance to make a name for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... But how should I make the most of this and get the word out...

dialogues.speaker: Boileau
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette?

dialogues.speaker: Corneille
dialogues.text: I probably shouldn't disturb them...

dialogues.speaker: Thibert
dialogues.text: Turn the murderer in!

dialogues.speaker: Suavegothe
dialogues.text: Melusines can't be trusted! That goes for Neuvillette too!

dialogues.speaker: Clotaire
dialogues.text: Peaceful coexistence? What a joke. Get out of the Court of Fontaine and don't ever come back!
